facts.fact: ART has finalised the draft concession convention and specifications for Starlink Cameroun SARL, passed to the technical supervisory ministry in late November 2025 for possible grant; Starlink is only in position to obtain formal authorisation, none yet issued.

Starlink announced stopping its services in Cameroon in April 2024 for lack of official authorisation and suspended access for Cameroonian users after the government demanded blocking of the grey-market use.
